body.message:
Apologies for the confusion. The previous message was sent by our AI generated, which is why our agent contacted you to confirm the details and provide you with the updated rates.

Unfortunately, as we operate holiday homes, our rates are dynamic and we are unable to offer the same rate for a 3-month period.

The rates shared above are our final rates for the requested period. Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the booking, and we will be happy to assist you.

Thank you for your understanding.
